WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_rate_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS overall_avg_rate_per_day
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT r.rating,
       r.avg_rate_per_day,
       r.avg_rate_per_day - o.overall_avg_rate_per_day AS above_overall_mean
FROM rating_averages r
CROSS JOIN overall_average o
WHERE r.avg_rate_per_day > o.overall_avg_rate_per_day;
